title: How much should a small business spend on marketing in 2026? | Mercury

facts.fact: Gartner's 2025 CMO Spend Survey reports that the average marketing spend is 7.7% of revenue (a third-party figure that the page notes includes established enterprise organizations).
facts.quote: the average marketing spend as a percentage of revenue is 7.7%

facts.fact: Using the Gartner 7.7% figure, the page says a business making $1M in a year should spend $77,000 on marketing.
facts.quote: meaning if your business makes $1M in a year, it should spend $77,000 on marketing

facts.fact: Mercury's guide says most small businesses can plan to spend between 5% and 20% of revenue on marketing, a rule of thumb the page presents without a cited source.
facts.quote: most small businesses can plan to spend between 5% and 20% of revenue on marketing

facts.fact: Mercury's guide suggests early-stage or pre-revenue businesses spend 10% to 20% of projected revenue on marketing.
facts.quote: 10% to 20% of projected revenue. This stage prioritizes awareness, validation, and learning what channels convert.

facts.fact: Mercury's guide suggests growing small businesses spend 7% to 10% of revenue on marketing.
facts.quote: 7% to 10% of revenue. Focus shifts toward building repeatable acquisition

facts.fact: Mercury's guide suggests stable or mature businesses spend 4% to 7% of revenue on marketing.
facts.quote: 4% to 7% of revenue. Growth is often more predictable

facts.fact: According to 2024 research cited by the page, consumer packaged goods (CPG) companies spend roughly 25% of revenue on marketing.
facts.quote: CPG companies spend roughly 25% of revenue on marketing, while financial services companies spend 9-10%.

facts.fact: According to 2024 research cited by the page, financial services companies spend 9-10% of revenue on marketing.
According to 2024 research cited by the page, professional services businesses spend 20-21% of revenue on marketing.
According to 2024 research cited by the page, retail businesses spend 14-15% of revenue on marketing.
According to 2024 research cited by the page, SaaS businesses spend 15% of revenue on marketing.
The Mercury article was published December 23, 2025 and last updated July 23, 2026.
